first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved road in the lower part of the main view, broad at the near end, first curving left ahead and then revealing the entrance to a right turn.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: The silver-gray, multilayer horizontal railings extending along both sides of the road.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The narrow strips arranged along the edges of the turns, with alternating red and white blocks on their surfaces.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The blue background above the mountain and the top of the slope, with light-colored cloud patterns visible in places.

entities.name: Lake Surface
entities.identification: The flat blue-gray water surface outside the guardrail on the right side of the main view during the early portion.

entities.name: Distant Mountain
entities.identification: The background mountain with an undulating blue-purple outline, behind the nearby slope and lakeshore.

entities.name: Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall
entities.identification: The low strip-like barrier wall below the white billboards, with repeated yellow markings on a black background.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The orange text fixed on the screen, the rear-view frame at the top, the route map at the lower left, the instrument at the lower right, and the green symbols on the right.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The elevated slope surfaces and slope bases on the left side of the road and ahead, excluding the main body of vegetation covering them.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The green cover on the slope and roadside, the row of trees along the top of the slope, and the background vegetation cluster on the opposite shore of the lake.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The tiny image of a yellow vehicle on the road in the top rear-view frame, with no identity correspondence established with any vehicle in the main view.

entities.name: Two White Billboards by the Lake
entities.identification: Two white sign faces at the base of the slope, one more front-facing with a red-and-blue pattern and the other appearing as a narrow side view.
